approved: Defence Home Ownership Assistance Scheme Amendment Bill 2022
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
The bill would make it easier for Australian Defence Force members to get home loan subsidies.
It would shorten the time members must serve before qualifying, remove the five-year limit on applying after leaving the force, and let the Secretary fix mistakes that stop subsidies.
A new mechanism would let the Commonwealth recover payments made in error to avoid constitutional problems.
Removes the five-year limit for former members to apply for a subsidy certificate.
Reduces the minimum service periods needed for initial access and each subsidy tier.
Lets the Secretary declare a subsidy ceasing event did not happen if it was due to a genuine error, mistake or accident.
Adds a recoverable payments mechanism for payments made in good faith but not authorised by the Act.
Current and former Australian Defence Force members and their families.
Defence Home Ownership Assistance Scheme Amendment Act 2022
